hypothesis: A completed maintenance-gap acceptance or failure may own direction until both CL and matched MCL cross their frozen pre-maintenance closes against that position. The same origin is symmetric for follow-acceptance and fade-failure; one event and one position per session prevent churn.

frozen_lifecycle.signal: exact V61 dominant-CL maintenance-gap and completed joint fifteen-minute acceptance/failure verdict
frozen_lifecycle.direction: follow CL gap acceptance; fade CL gap failure
frozen_lifecycle.entry: next executable matched-suffix MCL minute open
frozen_lifecycle.ordinary_exit: next minute open after both completed five-minute CL and MCL closes cross their own frozen pre-maintenance close against the position
frozen_lifecycle.forced_exit: last available close before session or contract boundary; first open after unexpected same-session gap; independent discovery/validation period flat
frozen_lifecycle.overlap_reentry: one MCL position and maximum one frozen event per session

period_gate.directions_and_branches: each >=20 trades and stress net positive
period_gate.weekday_weekend: weekday >=50 and weekend >=20 trades; each stress net positive

outcome_order: replay discovery only from a flat period boundary and evaluate every frozen gate
seal validation if any discovery gate fails
only after a complete pass replay untouched validation independently from flat
evaluate validation and combined-prefix gates without changing signal, direction, origin, or exit
prohibitions: no gap/origin magnitude, MCL-opening selector, alternate verdict clock, volume, flow, VWAP, retained state, ATR, news, stop, target, timeout, cooldown, branch inversion, replacement, or parameter neighbor
no validation exposure after discovery failure, V18 composition, order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract challenge year
unseen runtime/backtest parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL liquidity, spread, commission, roll, margin, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
